title: Lupus & Sjogren's Thriver
content: Lupus & Sjogren's ThriverRadical Remission ProjectMay 15, 20241 min readWhen Erin was 28 years old, she was diagnosed with Lupus and Sjogren’s. She took this as an opportunity to discover her body, mind, and soul, which has been enlivening. Navigating life, loss, and motherhood, Erin understands how pushing her body to do what she wants isn't always what it needs. She believe that at any age, or stage of life, we can empower ourselves to live the life that is right for us.Erin is a Registered Nurse, Yoga Teacher (specializing in Restorative Yoga), Trained Grief Support Group Facilitator, and Certified Radical Remission Health Coach, in addition to being a Wife and Mother of 4.Learn more about Erin at CaliCountryYoga.comListen to Erin's story and others like it here.162162 views00 commentsPost not marked as liked
